\text {万能公式:} \left\{ \begin{array}{l} \sin x = \frac {\sin x}{1} = \frac {2 \sin \frac {x}{2} \cos \frac {x}{2}}{\sin^ {2} \frac {x}{2} + \cos^ {2} \frac {x}{2}} = \frac {2 \tan \frac {x}{2}}{1 + \tan^ {2} \frac {x}{2}} \\ \cos x = \frac {\cos x}{1} = \frac {\cos^ {2} \frac {x}{2} - \sin^ {2} \frac {x}{2}}{\cos^ {2} \frac {x}{2} + \sin^ {2} \frac {x}{2}} = \frac {1 - \tan^ {2} \frac {x}{2}}{1 + \tan^ {2} \frac {x}{2}} \\ \tan x = \frac {2 \tan \frac {x}{2}}{1 - \tan^ {2} \frac {x}{2}} \end{array} \right.

4. 含三角的分式，如果异名，还可考虑万能公式：
比如：求 \(f(x) = \frac{1 + \sin x}{2 - 3\cos x} (x\in \mathrm{R})\) 的值域：

(1) 令 \(\tan \frac{x}{2} = t \Rightarrow \begin{cases} \sin x = \frac{2t}{1 + t^2} \\ \cos x = \frac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2} \neq \frac{2}{3} \end{cases} \Rightarrow \frac{1 - \sin x}{2 - 3\cos x} = \frac{1 - \frac{2t}{1 + t^2}}{2 - 3 \cdot \frac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2}} = \frac{1 + t^2 - 2t}{5^2 - 1} (5t \neq 1)\)

(2) 令  \( \frac{1+t^{2}-2t}{5t^{2}-1}=y \Rightarrow \begin{cases} (5y-1)t^{2}+2t-y-1=0 \\ \text{判别式法} \end{cases} \) 

 \( \Rightarrow \begin{cases} 5y-1=0 \text{ 时, } t=\frac{3}{5} \text{ 符合题意} \\ 5y-1\neq0 \text{ 时, } \Delta=4+4(5y-1)(y+1)\geq0 \end{cases} \Rightarrow y \geq0 \text{ 或 } y \leq\frac{4}{5} \)
